meta.name: Control Room
meta.description: A dark, signal-lit backend-engineering portfolio where real system architecture is the visual material.

color.strategy: Graphite field with bone-white ink and one amber status signal reserved for live, active, and emphasized states. No gradients or decorative semantic colors.

typography.strategy: Tight sentence-case sans statements, one serif-italic interruption per major heading, mono only for evidence and indices.

layout.desktop: 7/5 hero with topology figure, 3/9 section heads, three-column principles, scrolling project list beside a sticky request-path panel, full-width stack table, oversized contact.
layout.mobile: Single column; each project renders its own inline pipeline; no sticky panel.
layout.shape: Square fields and one-pixel rules; no radius system.

design_style.focal_strategy: Typographic scale plus one live architectural figure
design_style.ornamentation: Functional only: rules, indices, and signal traffic

visual_effects.technology: GSAP ScrollTrigger, SVG animateMotion, CSS transitions, IntersectionObserver
visual_effects.hero: Statement lines rise from masks; topology edges draw in, and amber packets travel fixed routes through the illustrative system.
visual_effects.projects: The active project is chosen by viewport middle band; the sticky panel crossfades to its architecture pipeline with a travelling packet and staggered nodes.
visual_effects.reveals: Section headings lift in once; principle rules scale from the left; a top progress bar scrubs with the page.
visual_effects.reduced_motion: Packets, pulses, and all scripted motion are removed while semantic content remains in normal flow.
visual_effects.performance: Transform, opacity, and SVG motion paths only; no WebGL, canvas, video, or particle systems.
